content: {"reasoning":"The claim was submitted clean only 12 days ago and no payer response is on the table; it is still within the 90-day timely filing window (44 days left). Prior auth is not required for CPT 93271, so the 'missing' authorization is irrelevant, and no retro-auth/P2P is offered anyway. Resubmitting (submit_clean/submit_with_records) risks a CO-18 duplicate denial, appeal/P2P/provide_info require a denial or request that doesn't exist, and billing/writing off the balance is premature since the payer is expected to pay. No available action can properly advance an already-pending, correctly filed claim.","action":"escalate"}
